issues.title: Redesign role workspaces into production-ready task flows

Each role sees only role-relevant work surfaces.
No primary role page stacks all available features in one long mixed page.
Mobile and desktop layouts remain responsive and performant.
Relevant verification completed before close.
verification: docs/BUSINESS_PROCESS.md and docs/UI_UX_CONTRACT.md updated before frontend implementation
src/App.vue refactored to add production workspace task cards and role-specific task surfaces

issues.title: Split Operator workspace into input, draft, and recent submissions
scope: Make Operator workspace focused on fast production input.
Separate draft/sync status and recent submissions from the main form without clutter.
Keep mobile operator flow short and one-hand friendly.
acceptance_criteria: Operator does not see approval, management recap, or backend maintenance surfaces.
Submit, autosave, queue, and recent submissions remain visible without long scrolling.
Offline-tolerant state behavior remains unchanged.
verification: Operator view now prioritizes input, draft state, sync queue, and validation readiness
IndexedDB/offline-tolerant state services were not changed

issues.title: Split Mandor workspace into approval inbox, conflict queue, and closing
scope: Separate pending approval, conflict review, and daily closing into clear task surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Default Mandor view prioritizes items requiring action.
CONFLICT_PENDING data is visually isolated from normal approval.
Closing flow is discoverable without mixing with operator input.
verification: Mandor view now starts with action cards for pending approval, conflict queue, and closing
Approval table is labeled as Work Queue and detail/action panel remains separate

issues.title: Build Supervisor control center with alert-first layout
scope: Prioritize anomalies, bottlenecks, missing closing, and reject spikes.
Group line/shift control data into dashboard cards and focused work queues.
Lazy-load heavy control data only when Supervisor workspace opens.
acceptance_criteria: Supervisor first sees alerts and production control status.
Heavy API data is not loaded during Operator startup.
Adjustment and closing signals are clear.
verification: Supervisor view now starts with alert-first cards for quarantine, closing, and adjustment
Existing lazy-load behavior in switchView remains unchanged

issues.title: Build Management read-only KPI dashboard task flow
scope: Make Management workspace read-only and insight-focused.
Prioritize MASTER_RECAP KPI, trends, Pareto defect, and export/report surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Management view only uses approved/final recap data.
CONFLICT_PENDING data is excluded from final KPI views.
No write actions appear except allowed export/filter/report actions.
verification: Management view now starts with read-only insight cards from dashboard summary data
Existing MASTER_RECAP dashboard source remains unchanged
